# Tri-City Electrical Contractors

Wiring Florida Since 1958

Here at Tri-City, we can handle any project from start to finish, from wire to wire — locally and throughout the State of Florida. If you’re looking to work with an employee-owned company that has been a staple of the Florida construction industry for more than six decades, you’ve found the right place.

[Explore Careers](https://www.tcelectric.com/careers/)

[Learn About Us](https://www.tcelectric.com/about/)

Experts in our field

### Florida’s Electrical Contractor

For over half a century, Tri-City has provided a level of personal attention, professional experience, timely performance, and genuine value that has become Florida’s construction industry standard for excellence. We leverage the latest construction technologies to provide our clients with state-of-the-art electrical solutions that enhance the functionality and appeal of their commercial, mixed-use and residential projects. At Tri-City, we understand that every project is unique. Our client-centered approach ensures that we deliver solutions tailored to the specific needs and goals of each customer and client.

Careers

## Advance Your Career

For more than 66 years, Tri-City has fostered an environment where each employee is valued and their contributions celebrated. From those entering the trade for the first time, to seasoned veterans, everyone at Tri-City is encouraged to grow professionally through ongoing training, mentorship, and exposure to diverse projects. We prioritize a healthy work-life balance and will do whatever it takes to make sure you are successful in your career.

[Explore Careers](https://www.tcelectric.com/careers/)

![Tri-City Electrical Contractors A group of fifteen people posing for a group photo in a conference room. They are smiling and dressed in business casual attire. A table with red gift bags and a stage are visible in the background.](https://www.tcelectric.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/ApprenticeshipGraduatesFEAT2023-1024x768.jpg)

## Our People

Our culture isn’t just a buzzword – it’s the heartbeat of our company. We know better than anyone that a strong company culture fosters growth and success, and we’re committed to doing whatever we can to elevate the experience for each of our employee-owners.
